markers.name: 14th Political Prison
markers.note: A walled prison on a cleared plateau in the North Korean wilderness. Watchtowers on every corner, barracks on the east side and the main gate to the south. The Citadel Fortress sits inside the yard.

markers.name: Chang-san Air Base
markers.note: A North Korean air base cut into a granite hillside, with an underground bunker bigger than the base above it. Cliffs guard the east side; the woods to the south are the usual way in. The outside is Critical, the bunker Extreme. Lieutenant Bale holds the Tank Depot in the bunker.

markers.name: Deadtown
markers.note: An empty farming town taken over by the army, with toxic rivers to the northwest and east and sewers running under the main buildings. Light resistance and street fights; the two Re-Education Centers hold the better targets.

markers.name: Imjin Farmland
markers.note: Flat rice fields, waterways and rail lines on the southwest border, with the Rice Mill Fortress in the middle. Long sightlines and little cover, so move carefully or use a vehicle.

markers.name: Cheongun Village
markers.note: A gambling town on the Hajin River with border crossings into Russia to the east and west. Expressway No. 1 runs along its south edge. The Heavenly Luck Casino Fortress dominates it.

markers.name: Haneul Nuclear Reactor
markers.note: A radioactive cloud hangs over the whole site and gets worse inside the reactor. Bring radiation gear and a gas mask; Radiation Blockers help. Fire Stations are where to find the gear.

markers.name: Mirae General Hospital
markers.note: Hajin's main hospital, next to a train station with The Grid and the mall to the east. Triage tents and barracks outside, close-quarters fights through the wards inside. Snipers like the woods of Mujin Pass to the south. Also a Fortress.

markers.name: NuriGo Mall
markers.note: A shopping district under the city's towers: police station, clinic, City Hall, a monorail stop and car parks. Three round structures in the main courtyard lead down to a huge dark underground mall (bring NVGs), which is the NuriGO Mall Fortress. Lieutenant Jang-ui camps here. West is High threat, East Medium.

markers.name: Cheonwang Peak Array
markers.note: Hajin's biggest telecom array on a flat summit, now an enemy base. Boulder trails to the west, gentler woods north toward Mujin Pass. The roof has a helipad and long views.

markers.name: The Grid
markers.note: The walled, razor-wired heart of Hajin City: barricaded streets, watchtowers and roaming patrols. Includes Donpyeong Gate, Hanex Bank, the DBN TV tower (the tallest building in Hajin) and the red-roofed Nenshin Tech Complex, which is Extreme threat.

markers.name: Songdo Wharf
markers.note: A quieter waterfront between the reactor and the river, with working train and monorail lines. The La Grande Vie tower is the tallest building nearby; a market, pier, lighthouse and Oamsik Turtle Island are on the coast.

markers.name: Wolves Stadium
markers.note: A ruined baseball stadium with a collapsed apartment tower beside it, an open-air theatre to the north and a police station and bank in the streets around. The edge with The Grid to the north is the dangerous part.

markers.name: Hajin River Heights
markers.note: Battered apartments and narrow shopping streets south of the stadium, rising toward the river's south fork. One apartment block is Compound Echo; Jinseo Park Towers and South Island's comms tower are further south.

markers.name: Hanrim Village
markers.note: Lieutenant Gorani, a ghillie-suited sniper, hunts from the woods above this village.

markers.name: The Citadel
markers.note: A Y-shaped Fortress inside the prison yard: gantries, cell blocks and a furnace, with high-value targets throughout. Easy to get cut off, so learn the layout. Critical threat.

markers.name: Heavenly Luck Casino
markers.note: A multi-floor casino with an underground car park. No power, so the gambling halls are dark mazes: bring NVGs. High threat.

markers.name: Mirae General Hospital
markers.note: The hospital itself is a Fortress: expect close-quarters fights through the wards and lobby.

markers.name: Admin Complex No. 2
markers.note: The command Fortress at Chang-san Air Base. Extreme threat.

markers.name: Re-Education Center
markers.note: Two central buildings in Deadtown where enemy numbers build up. The town around them has a Clinic and a Gas Station at each end.

markers.name: Rice Mill
markers.note: A Fortress on high ground over the farmland. Use the warehouses as cover on the way in, watch for enemy vehicles in the open, and switch to close-range weapons inside.

markers.name: NuriGO Mall
markers.note: The underground mall beneath the NuriGO courtyard: a sprawling, unlit shopping level. Bring NVGs. The Warden's key opens a sealed door down here.

markers.name: Vault Armory
markers.note: Epic key, grid F4. Opens the small armory in the casino's underground car park.

markers.name: Imjin Mill Foreman's Office
markers.note: Rare key, grid D8. Opens the foreman's office on the first floor of the Rice Mill.

markers.name: The Citadel South Wing
markers.note: Uncommon key. Opens the South Wing of the Citadel inside the prison.

markers.name: Re-Education Center Annex
markers.note: Epic key, grid B7. Opens the annex on the ground floor of the Re-Education Center in Deadtown.

markers.name: Iskra's Control Room
markers.note: Legendary key, grid F7. Opens the control room on the upper floor of the broadcast building.

markers.name: Counting Room Vault
markers.note: Epic key, grid F4. Opens the counting-room vault on the casino's main floor; players report a backpack inside.

markers.name: Reactor DRC Locker
markers.note: Ultra key, grid H4. Opens the DRC Weapons Locker in Reactor 02's irradiated pool. Bring radiation gear.

markers.name: Executive Arms Auction
markers.note: Epic key, grid G6. Opens the arms auction room at the top of DBN Headquarters, the tallest building in The Grid.

markers.name: Mirae Electrical Room
markers.note: Rare key, grid F5. Opens the electrical room in the hospital's northwestern basement car park.

markers.name: Reactor 02 Control Room
markers.note: Rare key, grid H4. Opens the control room inside the Reactor 02 building.

markers.name: The Doctor's Command Office
markers.note: Legendary key, grid F5. Opens a converted conference room in the hospital's upper-floor offices, behind wooden double doors.

markers.name: Gas Station Electrical Room
markers.note: Rare key, grid H6. Opens the gas station's electrical room: a grey metal door beside a noticeboard.

markers.name: Shopping DRC Locker
markers.note: Ultra key, grid H5. Reported to open the DRC Locker in the DRC Labs under the mall, in the secured lower car park.

markers.name: Mechanic's Shack
markers.note: Rare key, grid F5. Opens the standalone shack south of the clinic.

markers.name: Militia Arms Depot
markers.note: Rare key, grid G7. Opens the lower-floor armory in Gangbyeon Apartment B.

markers.name: Air Base DRC Weapons Locker
markers.note: Ultra key, grid B6. Opens the DRC Weapons Locker in the secure armory deep in the Chang-san Air Base bunker.

guide.title: Operator Prestige
guide.intro: An operator can Prestige once it has 18 Trait Points (spent or not) and isn't MIA. You pay the cash and hand in the gear below, equipped on the operator, and all of it is used up along with every trait you picked. In return the operator gets a random permanent trait. It can hold up to three, and from Prestige 4 you're offered a new one to swap in or turn down. Move anything you want to keep into your Stash first; Secure Slots don't protect it.

rows.title: Prestige 1
rows.subtitle: Hand in 2 weapons with 3 attachment slots (Rare or better), a Rare or better plate carrier and backpack, and 4 Rare or better ingredients

rows.title: Prestige 2
rows.subtitle: Hand in 2 weapons with 4 attachment slots, an Epic plate carrier and backpack, and 4 Epic ingredients

rows.title: Prestige 3 and later
rows.subtitle: Hand in 2 weapons with 4 attachment slots, a Legendary plate carrier and backpack, and 4 Legendary ingredients

rows.title: If Prestige won't go through
rows.subtitle: Activision is looking into a Prestige bug. Its workaround is to equip Rare weapons with three attachment slots that have never had four or more attachments; just removing an attachment doesn't count

guide.title: Traits
guide.intro: Each operator has three trees: Warfighter, Scout and Survivalist. You pick one trait per row, 9 per tree and 18 at most, with points from levelling your operator's dog tag (about 1,900 XP a point at Silver). The two-choice rows are fixed; the three-choice rows (five of the eight) are random for each operator and show once you take a trait from the row below (trees are climbed from the bottom). There's no reroll: the random rows seem to change only when you prestige the operator. Scout is shown as one example, from Ghost; yours will differ in the random rows. Tap any trait to see what it does.

traits.name: Adaptive Restock
traits.effect: Enemies drop one extra item

traits.name: Ammo Scavenger
traits.effect: Double ammo from ammo packs

traits.name: Cash Ops
traits.effect: 20% more cash from completing Ops

traits.name: Combat Resistance
traits.effect: Less damage from explosives and weaker enemy tactical effects

traits.name: Consumable Stacker
traits.effect: Using a consumable that's already active adds to its time, up to twice the normal length. A random-row trait in the middle section

traits.name: Container Looter
traits.effect: A chance of an extra piece of loot in containers

traits.name: Die Hard
traits.effect: In Last Stand, reaching an exfil calls it for you, and you never bleed out

traits.name: Equipment Professional
traits.effect: Lethals and Tacticals slowly recharge after use, up to the slot's max

traits.name: Expedited Extraction
traits.effect: Exfils arrive much faster. A random-row trait in the top section

traits.name: Fast Learner
traits.effect: A little more operator XP

traits.name: Faster Revive
traits.effect: Faster revives. One of the two fixed traits in the bottom section

traits.name: Field Crafting
traits.effect: Craft items from Common printer resources while deployed

traits.name: Field Medic
traits.effect: Revive allies faster

traits.name: Final Intel
traits.effect: The final exfil is marked on your Tac Map from the start

traits.name: Fuel Economy
traits.effect: Vehicles use less fuel. A random-row trait in the middle section

traits.name: Hostile Looter
traits.effect: Enemies sometimes drop an Uncommon printer ingredient, and very rarely a Rare one

traits.name: Impact Smokes
traits.effect: Releases smoke when you're downed

traits.name: Investor
traits.effect: A little more cash when you extract

traits.name: Key Cash
traits.effect: Opening a locked room with a key pays cash; rarer keys pay more

traits.name: Mini Tracker
traits.effect: Looting an unopened container has a 50% chance to send out a radar pulse

traits.name: Overwatch
traits.effect: UAV Towers you activate never expire

traits.name: Pack Rat
traits.effect: 20% more printer resource capacity. Stacks with Resource Hoarder

traits.name: Popcorn Lethals
traits.effect: Hostiles hit by your Lethals are more likely to drop Lethals. A random-row trait in the top section

traits.name: Popcorn Tacticals
traits.effect: Enemies hit by your Tacticals are more likely to drop Tacticals

traits.name: Possum
traits.effect: Once per match, self-revive from death into Last Stand with full health

traits.name: Quick Fix
traits.effect: Shorter health regen delay after you kill an enemy operator or hostile

traits.name: Quick Knife
traits.effect: Your weapon bash becomes a knife attack

traits.name: Rad Blocker
traits.effect: Less damage from radiation. A random-row trait in the middle section

traits.name: Randomized Trait
traits.effect: Revealed once you take a trait from the row before

traits.name: Rescuer
traits.effect: Move faster while dragging a downed teammate. A random-row trait in the top section

traits.name: Resource Hoarder
traits.effect: 20% more printer resource capacity. Stacks with Pack Rat

traits.name: Resource Management
traits.effect: Resources you pick up past your cap top up whichever you have least of

traits.name: Resource Pockets
traits.effect: Scrapped items give 20% more printer resources

traits.name: Resupply
traits.effect: More ammo from restocks and ammo crates; Armor Boxes give 2 extra plates

traits.name: Stealthy
traits.effect: Kill more enemies before a Hunt Squad comes after you

traits.name: Thermal Padding
traits.effect: Hides you from UAVs and drops Advanced UAVs to normal UAV detection

traits.name: UAV Upgrade
traits.effect: Longer range and duration for UAVs, and they become Advanced UAVs

traits.name: Viper Sense
traits.effect: Warns you when enemy operators are nearby
